description: This Java class 'ToDoPresenter' manages the lifecycle and UI interactions of a ToDo application, including task management, filtering, routing, and local storage persistence.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter
classes.description: Main class managing ToDo items, UI updates, routing, and persistence.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter.View
classes.description: Interface for the view component, defining methods for UI interactions.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter.ViewEventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling user events from the view.

methods.name: ToDoPresenter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the presenter, loading state, setting up event handlers and routing.

methods.name: setupHistoryHandler
methods.description: Sets up routing based on URL history changes.

methods.name: parseRoutingToken
methods.description: Converts URL token into routing enum.

methods.name: updateFilteredList
methods.description: Filters tasks based on current routing state.

methods.name: updateTaskStatistics
methods.description: Calculates and updates task count and completion stats.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Removes a task and updates UI.

methods.name: itemStateChanged
methods.description: Handles task state changes, including removal if title is empty.

methods.name: taskStateChanged
methods.description: Updates filtered list, stats, and saves state.

methods.name: markAllCompleted
methods.description: Sets all tasks to completed or not.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task from user input.
